'''Azure Motorworks''' was a manufacturer of ground-based vehicles on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. They primarily developed luxury [[Groundcar/Legends|cars]] for the wealthy, such as the [[SirparSpeeder]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
